answer: Clone operators flood one cheap admission band. Each applicant is assigned a terrace, a reserved shelf holding only one live key. Occupancy is proven three times on a 7-hour spiral: shelf h, then h+11, then h+29, each a 12-minute puzzle from a disjoint reviewer. The applicant locks 24 POA for 6 epochs and pays 0.36 POA per reviewer. Reviewers post a short shale capsule (hmac of puzzle and reply) on the ledger. Peers recompute the shelf walk and capsules. A double-booked terrace, missed spiral step, or conflicting shale capsule slashes 31 percent to the reviewer and parks the key 5 epochs.
